attempts.certificate: 因299=13×23且263≡−1 (mod 132)，对与299互质的数有x^263≡x^−1 (mod 299)。逐项计算明文SANDBOX得281,247,156,22,222,53,17。解密密文得83,85,0,89,80,73,89，即S、U、NUL、Y、P、I、Y；其中299^263 mod 299=0，不是A-Z对应的ASCII值，因此第二问严格按规则无法得到全为大写字母的明文。

judges.reason: The canonical answer is incorrect, and the supplied ciphertext does not decrypt to all-uppercase letters under the stated rules. Since 263≡−1 (mod 264), coprime values decrypt to modular inverses: 281→83 (S), 197→85 (U), 299→0, 84→89 (Y), 228→80 (P), 213→73 (I), and 12→25. Also, encrypting SANDBOX gives [281,247,13,22,222,53,17], not the canonical [54,156,281,197,197,240,89].
